sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Infected Lab is a location in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: An underground TerraGroup Labs facility in central Tarkov that officially doesn't exist. The limited information available about its classified research has now been supplemented by reports of infected individuals carrying an unknown virus wandering the facility's interior.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
- This location can only be entered with a TerraGroup Labs access keycard.
- The illumination is turned off on this location.
- All doors are unlocked on this location.

sections.heading: Insurance
sections.text: All insured items left in a raid by players will not be returned. Upon death, insurance Traders will send the usual in-game mail about dispatching people to recover the items, but when the insurance timer runs out they will explain that their people don't go to the location, didn't find it or died in the process.
